hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */pnpm-lock.yaml|*/.env|*/.env.local|*/.env.*.local) echo "Protected file: $f. Change the lockfile with pnpm install; edit .env files yourself." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.mjs|*.css|*.json) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/vp" fmt --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0
